description: POC: exact-OCR a small synthetic receipt. Pass requires the literal dollar amount.

image_fixture.license: Crucible-owned synthetic; no real PII; generated for this test
image_fixture.notes: Hand-typed mock receipt for total = $42.50. Fixture file lands in a follow-up commit after license review.

questions.question: Read the total amount on this receipt. Reply with ONLY the dollar amount (e.g. $12.34).

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for vision_ocr_exact scorer. Until the PNG fixture lands, runner produces SKIPPED_FIXTURE_MISSING; thereafter, exact-match pass on $42.50.

known_scoring_limitations: Exact-match regex; a vision model that answers '$42.5' (no trailing 0) or '42.50' (no $) will fail. Acceptable for token-precision OCR.
